title: The Bidding
lyrics:
[00:23.26]I've been sleeping in a cardboard box
[00:25.61]Spending every dollar at the liquor shop
[00:28.27]And even though I know I haven't got a lot
[00:31.01]I'll try to give you love until the day you drop
[00:43.80]I've been training like a Pavlov dog
[00:46.16]Let my independence out to take a hike
[00:48.95]All you gotta do is activate my bell
[00:52.03]And I'll fetch you anything you like
[00:54.37]Going once, going twice
[00:57.10]Every man here has a price
[00:59.85]Over where? Over there?
[01:02.45]Sold to not a single lady in here
[01:05.81]I've been here like a thousand times
[01:08.07]Dated every woman in the atmosphere
[01:11.31]I've been to every continent
[01:13.51]Broken all the hearts in every hemisphere
[01:15.83]And if I'm not the type of guy you like to circumvent
[01:18.55]Just remember not to love me when I disappear
[01:20.92]I graduated at the top
[01:22.97]I like to take advantage of the bourgeoisie
[01:25.73]So if you have a fantasy of being a queen
[01:28.59]Maybe you should blow a couple bucks on me
[01:31.32]Going once, going twice
[01:34.02]Won't these gentlemen suffice?
[01:36.75]Any here? Any there?
[01:39.50]Any motions anywhere?
[01:42.25]Going twice, going thrice
[01:44.96]Guess this means we'll go four times a lady
[01:48.39]I promise I'll be all you'll need, ever need
[01:53.53]You'll never have to shop around, don't shop around
[01:59.23]And I'll give you all you'll ever need, ever need
[02:04.28]Don't worry, I will never let you down, let you down
[02:09.74]Don't worry, I will never let you down
[02:18.32]So many ladies are wanting for mates
[02:20.71]And the prospects are good, but the date's never great
[02:23.42]Over here, over there, over where? Anywhere
[02:26.17]They're too busy with winning the bidding to care
[02:28.92]And he's sold
